subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Plead
solution: The correct answer is **"Beseech."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Plead" **means to ask somebody for something in a very strong and serious way. (गंभीरतापूर्वक याचना करना, चिरौरी करना) • **Example**: *She **pleaded**__ with him not to leave her.* • **"Beseech" **is the synonym of** "Plead."** • **"Beseech"** means to ask for something earnestly or to beg for something. (अनुनय करना, विनती करना, विनतीपूर्वक मांगना) __ • **Example**: *She **beseeched**__ him to reconsider his decision.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Mourn** means to mourn or grieve silently. (दुख या शोक मनाना (विशेषतः किसी की मृत्‍यु पर)) • **Reject** means to refuse to accept or consider something. (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को अस्‍वीकार करना (मानने से इनकार करना)) • **Welcome** means to greet someone with pleasure or to be pleased with something. ((अतिथि का) स्‍वागत करना, अगवानी करना) 31:Td79, The correct answer is **"novel."**
